mermaid:
---
title: Bookstore data model
---
erDiagram
    direction TB
    AUTHOR ||--o{ BOOK_AUTHOR : writes
    BOOK ||--o{ BOOK_AUTHOR : "written by"
    PUBLISHER ||--o{ BOOK : publishes
    CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
    ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_LINE : contains
    BOOK ||--o{ ORDER_LINE : "ordered in"
    CUSTOMER ||--o{ REVIEW : writes
    BOOK ||--o{ REVIEW : receives
    BOOK {
        uuid id PK
        string isbn UK
        string title
        uuid publisher_id FK
        date published_on
        decimal price
    }
    AUTHOR {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        string bio
    }
    BOOK_AUTHOR {
        uuid book_id PK,FK
        uuid author_id PK,FK
        int author_order
    }
    PUBLISHER {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        string country
    }
    CUSTOMER {
        uuid id PK
        string email UK
        string name
        string address
    }
    ORDER {
        uuid id PK
        uuid customer_id FK
        datetime placed_at
        string status
        decimal total
    }
    ORDER_LINE {
        uuid id PK
        uuid order_id FK
        uuid book_id FK
        int quantity
        decimal unit_price
    }
    REVIEW {
        uuid id PK
        uuid book_id FK
        uuid customer_id FK
        int rating
        text body
        date created_at
    }
